subject: Operational telemetry onboarding — dashboards, tracing, and triage routing
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cloudbridge.io>, CloudBridge DevOps <devops@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Operational telemetry onboarding — dashboards, tracing, and triage routing

Hi Samantha — great to meet last week. Per our kickoff, I wanted to consolidate the immediate telemetry workstreams and owners so CloudBridge can hit your go-live window in early September. Proposed scope for the first run:

1) Dashboards: production API latency, error breakdown by route, token cost per request.
2) Tracing hooks: span propagation across frontend -> inference gateway -> model pool.
3) Error taxonomy: map service errors to triage buckets (retryable, throttling, model-failure, infra).
4) Alert routing & runbooks: who gets P1/P2/P3, escalation steps, and PagerDuty playbook links.

Action items (short):
- Redwood: deliver dashboard template and alert routing proposal by EOD Thu (Laura/Ben).
- CloudBridge: confirm the list of routes + rate limits and provide an initial SLO baseline (Samantha).
- Joint: schedule a 60-min instrumentation walkthrough next Tue.

Attachments: obs-dashboard-template.xlsx (dashboard starter), trace-hook-instrumentation.md (recommended tracer snippets), alert-routing-proposal.pdf (initial routing map).

Next step: Samantha — can you confirm that Tuesday 8/19 10:00am PT works for your engineering team?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.com
Office: (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: obs-dashboard-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)] [Attachment: trace-hook-instrumentation.md (text)] [Attachment: alert-routing-proposal.pdf (pdf)]

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cloudbridge.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudBridge DevOps <devops@cloudbridge.io>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Operational telemetry onboarding — dashboards, tracing, and triage routing

Thanks Priyom — Tuesday 8/19 10:00am PT works for us. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- Our immediate go-live will include the user-facing chat endpoint (/api/v1/chat) and a batch embeddings pipeline. We'll provide sample traffic patterns by tomorrow.
- For tracing, we currently sample at 5% at the edge; we can increase to 20% for the first 72 hours around go-live if needed.
- PagerDuty: we have a primary on-call squad (CloudBridge-Platform) and a secondary app on-call (CloudBridge-App). Please route P1s to Platform first.

Would appreciate if Redwood can call out any expected tagging conventions for spans (service, route, model_id, request_id) so our instrumentation leads can align.

Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Engineering | CloudBridge
samantha.lee@cloudbridge.io
[--CloudBridge internal signature removed--]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: CloudBridge DevOps <devops@cloudbridge.io>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Operational telemetry onboarding — dashboards, tracing, and triage routing

Thanks — quick follow-up with specifics from the Redwood ops side. Outline attached (alert-routing-proposal.pdf). High level:

Dashboard templates (what we'll deliver):
- Prod API overview: p50/p95/p99 latency, req/sec, error rate (5xx/4xx).
- Route breakdown: for /api/v1/chat and /api/v1/embeddings, token cost per request and median response time.
- Model health: queue depth, batch sizing, and inference time per model variant.

Tracing conventions (recommended tags):
- service.name: frontend|gateway|model-serve
- http.route: literal route path
- model.id: model family + quantization tag (e.g., galactica-7b.q4)
- request.id: our correlation id (trace-id as request_id)

Error taxonomy (short):
- RETRYABLE: transient network timeouts, upstream rate limits.
- MODEL_FAILURE: hallucination detection, decoder errors, shape-mismatch.
- INFRA_FAILURE: GPU OOM, node crash, disk errors.
- CONFIG: auth failures, bad payloads (4xx).

Alert routing (proposal):
- P1: INFRA_FAILURE -> CloudBridge-Platform (PagerDuty) + Redwood on-call
- P2: MODEL_FAILURE -> CloudBridge-App -> Redwood MLOps (email then slack)
- P3: CONFIG/DEGRADED -> ticketed to CloudBridge backlog, notify Redwood CSM/AE

Runbook frag: we will hand over a short P1 runbook for each alert (escalation, rollback command, communication checklist).

Attaching the three docs I shared in the kickoff. If those look good I will create the shared runbook within your Drive folder and invite CloudBridge-Platform.

Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cell: (650) 555-0124

[Attachment: alert-routing-proposal.pdf]

On Tue, Aug 12, 2025 at 08:27 AM PDT, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com> wrote:

> Tracing conventions (recommended tags):
> - service.name: frontend|gateway|model-serve
> - http.route: literal route path
> - model.id: model family + quantization tag (e.g., galactica-7b.q4)
> - request.id: our correlation id (trace-id as request_id)

Thanks Laura — quick notes from our instrumentation engineer (Benji):
- We'll add service.name and request_id today. We prefer model.version rather than model.id (less ambiguous for our release pipeline). Can Redwood accept model.version tag as well?
- For sampling, we'll open a short window of 20% and forward spans to your tracing endpoint (please confirm ingest endpoint and auth header).
- Confirmed the routes: /api/v1/chat, /api/v1/embeddings, /api/v1/batch-embed (we missed this in the kickoff).

Also, can you confirm the expected retention window for traces vs logs? We plan to keep traces 7 days, logs 30 days by default unless you advise otherwise.

—CloudBridge DevOps
[Attachment: instrumentation-notes.txt]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: DevOps Team <devops@cloudbridge.io>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cloudbridge.io>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Operational telemetry onboarding — dashboards, tracing, and triage routing

Hi all — summary and concrete asks before the 8/19 walkthrough: 

1) Tags: we can accept model.version in addition to model.id. Please include both for parity; model.version will populate on your side as release tag.
2) Tracing endpoint: ingest.redwood.com/traces (use header x-redwood-key: <token-we-sent-via-secure-channel>). We'll send a short test token to CloudBridge infra.
3) Retention guidance: for this initial go-live we recommend traces 7 days, logs 30 days — you can extend traces for critical windows to 30 days if you expect to do deep post-mortem.

I'll upload the P1 runbook to the Drive folder and paste the link in the walkthrough notes. Looking forward to the call tomorrow.

Ben Carter
Technical Program Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
[Attachment: P1-runbook.md]
